title: ExceptionalDerivedSiteRealization
statement: For the ordinary normalized etale/pro-etale site comparison of [def-pur-adic-site-realization], derive its inverse-image comparison by exact localization, characterized by its full factorization square on every cochain representative. Derive its direct-image comparison by the universal right-derived-unit square on every cochain representative, using the ordinary direct-image comparison. These equations uniquely determine both natural isomorphisms.

proof.text: Compose the specified inverse factorization and both exact realization factorizations to obtain the two functors on cochain complexes. Whisker the ordinary normalized inverse comparison with Q. Full faithfulness of precomposition with Q lifts this isomorphism uniquely; cancel the target factorization to obtain exactly the displayed representative square.

The pro-etale scalar realization is an exact additive equivalence to the Grothendieck abelian category of module-valued sheaves. Transport Grothendieck abelianness along this equivalence and obtain K-injective resolutions. The realization preserves K-injective complexes because its inverse is an exact left adjoint.

On cochain complexes form two units with common source F_complex H_complex Q: the first is the inverse H factorization followed by H_derived applied to the specified coefficient direct unit; the second is the localized ordinary direct comparison, the site direct unit, and site-derived direct applied to the inverse G factorization. Both units are invertible on every K-injective complex: the given coefficient unit computes there and the site unit computes after G, which preserves K-injectives. The K-injective derivability structure therefore makes both composite functors universal right derived functors. Right-derived uniqueness gives a unique isomorphism preserving these units. Cancel the exact realization factorizations to obtain precisely the displayed normalization on every complex; universal uniqueness also proves uniqueness for this equation.

proof_origin.note: Retains the inverse localization proof and completes the direct comparison using K-injective derivability and uniqueness. All categorical helpers are private and proved; no new public statements or holes.
